mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the revised rule on fresh Wednesday cases was most worthwhile: it showed a human handoff working on a different problem, not just the one used to revise the rule.

leastWorthwhile.text: The talkbox assembly was straightforward and somewhat predictable compared with the routing decisions, though its accessibility details were useful.

surprise.text: The Tuesday test revealed that a two-carrier pickup was wrongly rejected because the rule could book only one volunteer, even though a dispatcher could arrange a pair.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the talkbox parts had clear functions, and the revised rule needed a fresh test.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the concrete failures and human workarounds made me curious how the neighborhood's systems might develop, even if the repairs themselves were fairly predictable.
